limitations: Occupied classification comes from model references and requires inspection against all plates in geometry-ledger.json. Missing/unreferenced habitable floors must be reported separately.
Projection union is occupied slab footprint across levels, not site area, net enclosed floor area or roof/eave footprint.
Union removes overlaps within each 1 mm datum bucket; near-duplicate slabs at different heights need manual review. Slab datums do not certify storeys or usable stair connections.
Horizontal y-axis profiles use actual polygons with holes; other axes remain unverified.

Use the full programme/physical/relationship audits and rendered review for enclosure, six distinct suites, access, major spaces, infinity edge, landscaping and design. No area total establishes success.
